svg.text: I build and run business systems: ERPNext and Frappe implementations, custom

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: web platforms, and the integrations and infrastructure underneath them. Most

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of the work sits in Tanzania and the wider East Africa Community, where paper

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and spreadsheets have stopped keeping up with the operation.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: My background is on the infrastructure side, servers, networks and biometric

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: attendance, which is why I care less about the demo and more about what

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: happens at 08:00 on a Monday. Fewer spreadsheets, cleaner ledgers, records
